Package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.application.auth

Interface JwtTokenService

All Known Implementing Classes:
JwtTokenServiceAdapter
public interface JwtTokenService
Technical port for HS256 JWT issuance and verification (REQ-AUTH-002 / -003 / -010).

Sits behind the application/auth boundary so the LoginUseCase and the JwtAuthenticationFilter stay free of the JJWT library. The shipped adapter in v1 is JjwtTokenServiceAdapter.

  • Method Details

    • issue

      JwtTokenService.IssuedToken issue(User user)
      Issues a fresh signed JWT for user. Claims emitted: sub (email), role, uid (user id UUID), jti (fresh UUID), iat, exp = iat + configured lifetime.

    • verify

      JwtTokenService.TokenClaims verify(String rawToken)
      Validates rawToken's signature, expiry, and claim shape. Returns a JwtTokenService.TokenClaims on success. Throws InvalidCredentialsException on any failure (bad signature, expired, malformed, missing/invalid claim, unknown role) with the underlying cause attached for the logger but never surfaced to clients.
